 Leo Shani Horoscope Today, 27 October 2026: Shani Dhaiya in 8th calls for care with health and joint finances on Mangalvar 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Career Horoscope Love Horoscope Today Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Leo Shani Horoscope Today, 27 October 2026: Shani Dhaiya in 8th calls for care with health and joint finances on Mangalvar 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 27, 2026, 03:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Leo needs to pace itself carefully this Tuesday. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your eighth, keeps Dhaiya active, and on Mars’s weekday the chance of small accidents or sudden costs rises. The Moon moves into Taurus, your tenth, early in the day, where it is exalted in Krittika, a nakshatra ruled by your own ruler, the Sun. This gives steady footing at work, even as the eighth house calls for caution. Health Under Dhaiya on Mangalvar
 Mars governs blood and injuries, and Tuesday strengthens it. With Shani in the eighth, a flare-up of an old injury or rising blood pressure deserves attention. Handle sharp tools carefully in the kitchen or workshop. If a minor procedure is optional, consider scheduling it after Mercury turns direct in mid-November. Joint Finances
 The eighth house governs money shared with others, such as a joint account with a spouse or property co-owned with siblings. Review those accounts this week. Make sure everyone involved knows what is coming in and going out. Avoid adding new names to accounts or changing nominees while Mercury is retrograde. Exalted Moon in the Tenth
 The Moon in your tenth, exalted and in the Sun’s nakshatra, brings calm confidence at work despite Dhaiya. A senior may rely on your judgement today. Keep decisions practical. Your Ruler and Ketu
 The Sun, still weak in your third, with Mercury and Venus retrograde nearby, may leave you second-guessing. Ketu on your lagna adds to that. Rely on written facts rather than mood. Do’s for Today
 Handle sharp tools carefully. Review joint accounts with family this week. Don’ts for Today
 Avoid changing account holders or nominees this month. Do not ignore a flare-up of an old injury. Shani Remedy for Today
 Give knee support to an elderly labourer who works on their feet all day. Offer betel leaves to Hanuman on Tuesday evening.
